leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Vue shell application to serve as the host container for micro-frontends
Configure dynamic component loading to render micro-frontends on demand
Implement a shared state management system for communication between the shell and micro-frontends
Initialize and control routing within the shell to navigate between different micro-frontends
Apply CSS isolation techniques to prevent style conflicts between the shell and micro-frontends
Integrate a build configuration that supports independent deployment of micro-frontends
Manulate lifecycle hooks to manage the loading and unloading of micro-frontends
